helpers.name: private.is_admin()
helpers.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT private.active_account() AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles WHERE id=auth.uid() AND role='admin');
$function$

helpers.name: private.active_account()
helpers.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.active_account()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p JOIN auth.users u ON u.id=p.id WHERE p.id=auth.uid() AND NOT p.suspended AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
 AND (p.role<>'vendor' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.vendors v WHERE v.id=p.vendor_id AND v.owner_id=p.id AND v.status<>'suspended' AND v.archived_at IS NULL)));
$function$

helpers.name: admin_update_payment_gateway(text,boolean,boolean,text)
private.block_marketplace_provider()
helpers.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.block_marketplace_provider()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN IF NEW.provider IN('payfast','ozow') AND NEW.enabled THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Provider authorisation required: marketplace gateways are blocked. Reviewed provider approval and a new migration are required.'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $function$
